content.title: Online Responsive Image Tool
content.p1: Modern websites need to serve different image sizes to different devices to ensure fast load times. Our Responsive Image Generator automates this process by creating multiple resized versions of your image and generating the standard HTML `srcset` attribute.
content.p2: Simply upload your high-resolution photo, select the target breakpoints (e.g., mobile, tablet, desktop), and download your optimized images instantly.

resize.title: Batch Resizing
resize.desc: Automatically resize your image to standard web breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, etc.).

fast.title: Browser Processing
fast.desc: All processing happens safely in your browser. No files are uploaded to any server.

how_to.title: How to Use Srcset
list: Click 'Generate' to create the resized versions.
Copy the generated HTML code to your website.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: `srcset` is an HTML attribute that allows the browser to choose the most appropriate image size based on the user's screen width.
faq.a2: Not necessarily. Choose the ones that fit your website's layout. Common widths are 480w (mobile), 768w (tablet), and 1280w (desktop).
